top_signals.title: Saudi Oil Exports Rebound at Hormuz While East-West Pipeline Remains Offline
top_signals.summary: Saudi Arabia has sold as many as 60 million barrels of crude oil from the Persian Gulf port of Ras Tanura for September and October loadings outside the Strait of Hormuz via ship-to-ship transfers, trade sources told Reuters on Friday. Saudi oil giant Aramco has offered buyers of the crude from the Ras Tanura port to be loaded via ship-to-ship (STS) transfers at the port of Sohar in Oman just outside the Strait of Hormuz, according to the sources. top_signals.title: Black Sea Chaos Is Forcing Russian Farmers to Plant Less Wheat
top_signals.summary: Some Russian farmers plan to plant less winter wheat as flows from the country’s crucial Black Sea ports remain stalled, creating a domestic glut and setting the stage for a smaller 2027 harvest from the world’s top shipper.
